task.title: Relics: a long-lived reader takes a new relic reader for each request
task.description:
A relic is a record in Workbook beside tasks. It holds specs, plans, decisions and similar material as named parts, with the same history and sharing that tasks have.

This is a follow-up from the review of the first six relics stories (finding M28). It was left out of that work on purpose.

## Problem

A relic reader indexes once and keeps answering from that pass. That is right for one command. A web board or any other long-lived process that kept one reader would serve stale relics.

## Wanted

Say so in the reader's doc comment, and make the board create a reader for each request.

## Done when

- The doc comment states the lifetime rule.
- A test shows the board serves a relic changed after the board started.

## Notes

Do this with "Relics: add relics to the web board".
